environment.description: Same EC2 instance and application deployed in EKS cluster (v1.28) with Istio service mesh (v1.20.2). The workload runs in namespace 'legacy-apps'. An Istio AuthorizationPolicy resource named 'deny-cross-ns-to-legacy-admin' is applied in the 'legacy-apps' namespace with spec.action DENY, matching requests where source.namespace is NOT 'legacy-apps' AND the request path prefix is '/internal/'. Additionally, a second AuthorizationPolicy 'allow-only-batch-sa' with action ALLOW restricts '/internal/admin/*' paths to only requests with source.principal matching 'cluster.local/ns/legacy-apps/sa/batch-processor-sa'. The mesh operates in STRICT mTLS mode (PeerAuthentication mesh-wide). The Envoy sidecar intercepts all inbound traffic on port 8080 before it reaches the application container. Note: the INTERNAL_ADMIN_TOKEN is still the default value, and the code vulnerabilities remain present - the authorization is enforced at the mesh proxy layer, not application layer.
